parts_fit.basis: mean of the team's top 7 rated players, fitted against its measured 2025 strength

meta.parts_note: a 2025 measurement on purpose: the 2026 team projection is built from 2025 production, so comparing the two would be circular and the gap would measure nothing
meta.residual_is_not_modelled: the weakest-link hypothesis was tested and failed twice -- roster spread carries a POSITIVE coefficient (+0.261) and rotation spread correlates -0.088 with team strength -- so the gap is reported as unexplained rather than attributed
